title: Opening at the IAJE convention in Toronto
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the interview and Howard Mandel.

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at the IAJE convention. I’m very pleased to have journalist Howard Mandel here.
It’s a pleasure to meet you and I’ve been reading you for a number of years. So thanks for coming.
